color.primitive.ink.$description: Text on paper, the dark ground, and the text and mark colour on an amber fill (about 6.1:1).

color.primitive.muted.$description: Secondary text on paper (5.5:1). On ink it is only 2.8:1, so the dark theme uses muted-dark.

color.primitive.grid.$description: Hairlines and grid edges on paper. Decoration, about 1.4:1 on paper.

color.primitive.amber.$description: AMBER RULE: signal amber is for fills and decoration only. 2.5:1 on paper, so never text or UI boundaries on the light ground; 6.1:1 on ink.

color.primitive.fish-band.$description: The clownfish band: 70% paper over amber. 1.9:1 against the body, decoration only.

color.primitive.on-amber-white.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: on amber, white takes the accent role (decoration, the fish body), about 2.5:1 so never text. Also the light card surface.

color.primitive.card-dark.$description: Dark theme card surface (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

color.primitive.muted-dark.$description: Dark theme secondary text (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

color.primitive.accent-text-dark.$description: Dark theme amber text (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

color.accent-on-amber.$description: ON-AMBER RULE, decoration only: white takes the accent role on an amber fill (the amber echo, the fish body). About 2.5:1 on amber, so it is never text; text on amber is on-accent (ink).

color.theme.light.card.$description: Light card surface, the motion board's card colour.

color.theme.light.accent-fill.$description: AMBER RULE: a fill and decoration colour only; never text or UI boundaries on the light ground (2.5:1 on paper). Text on it is on-accent.

color.theme.light.on-accent.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: text and the logo mark on an amber fill are ink (about 6.1:1). White on amber (accent-on-amber) is decoration only.

color.theme.dark.muted.$description: The dark theme's own muted: the light muted is 2.8:1 on ink.

color.theme.dark.accent-fill.$description: AMBER RULE: a fill and decoration colour. Amber is 6.1:1 on ink, but text uses accent-text, and on the light ground amber is never text or a boundary. Text on it is on-accent.

color.theme.dark.on-accent.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: text and the logo mark on an amber fill are ink (about 6.1:1). White on amber (accent-on-amber) is decoration only.

font.family.sans.$description: Onest, system fallbacks. Display (800) and text (400).

font.family.mono.$description: DM Mono, system fallbacks. Labels and code.

radius.none.$description: The default. Buttons, cards, panels and inputs are square; emphasis comes from the chamfer, not from rounding.

radius.sm.$description: Justified exception: anti-aliasing softness on small inline elements such as code spans and keyboard hints, where a hard 0 corner looks jagged at 12 px. Never on buttons, cards or panels.

radius.full.$description: Justified exception: genuinely circular shapes only (status dots, avatars). Never a pill-shaped button; the chamfer is the brand's shape.

motion.duration.instant.$description: Hover colour, focus ring. Default easing: ease-out.

motion.duration.quick.$description: Button press, small toggles. Default easing: ease-out.

motion.duration.base.$description: Cards, panels, menus. Default easing: settle.

motion.duration.press.$description: The completion press (scale 1.04 to 1.06). Default easing: settle.

motion.duration.echo.$description: The amber echo after a meaningful completion. Default easing: echo.

motion.duration.draw.$description: Lines and outlines being drawn. Default easing: draw.

motion.duration.wipe.$description: Chamfer wipe between screens or scenes (500 ms in, 500 ms out). Default easing: draw.

motion.easing.draw.$description: Things being built: strokes and wipes. Slow start, slow finish.

motion.easing.settle.$description: Things arriving and settling: card text, the press.

motion.easing.echo.$description: The amber echo leaving the mark.

motion.easing.ease-out.$description: Hover, focus and small UI responses.

motion.press.scale.$description: Press scale, 1.05 by default within the allowed 1.04 to 1.06. Never a bounce (no overshoot).
